clinical_notes: chest x-rays of a 27-year-old male patient with covid-19 (a–d). the first radiograph at admission demonstrated a mild interstitial thickening in the lower lobes (a). within 72 h from hospital admission, his clinical conditions worsened and bilateral pulmonary consolidations became visible at chest x-ray (b). the same day he was intubated with a prompt improvement of the radiological findings especially in the left lung (c). in the next 24 h after the beginning of the mechanical ventilation, the bilateral pulmonary consolidations increased (d)
